```{r}
#| label: setup
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(glmmTMB)
  library(DHARMa)
  library(ggeffects)
  library(patchwork)
})

stored <- readRDS("data.rds")
fits <- readRDS("fits.rds")

plant <- params$plant
model <- params$model

# fitted models reference `data_by_plant` by name (from 00-prepare.R); DHARMa
# re-derives the model frame from that stored call, so it must exist here too
data_by_plant <- stored$data_by_plant

fit <- fits[[paste(plant, model, sep = ".")]]
plant_data <- stored$data_by_plant[[plant]]
plant_color <- stored$plant_colors[[plant]]

plant_label <- gsub("plant_", "Planta ", plant)
model_labels <- c(
  poisson = "Poisson (P)",
  nbinom2 = "Binomial negativa (NB)",
  zip     = "Inflación de ceros (ZIP)",
  zinb    = "Binomial negativa con inflación de ceros (ZINB)"
)
model_label <- model_labels[[model]]
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
cat("###", plant_label, "+ Modelo", model_label, "\n")
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 1.9
p1 <- plant_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = abundance)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, color = "white", fill = plant_color) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8)

p2 <- plant_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = distance, y = abundance)) +
  geom_point(color = plant_color) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8)

patchwork::wrap_plots(p1, p2)
```

```{r}
# condensed coefficient tables instead of the full summary() printout, to fit one page
s <- summary(fit)
fit_stats <- sprintf(
  "AIC = %.1f, BIC = %.1f, logLik = %.1f",
  s$AICtab[["AIC"]], s$AICtab[["BIC"]], s$AICtab[["logLik"]]
)
```

`r fit_stats`

**Modelo condicional (componente de conteo, coeficientes en escala log)**

```{r}
as.data.frame(s$coefficients$cond) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
if (!is.null(s$coefficients$zi)) {
  cat("**Modelo de inflaci\u00f3n de ceros (probabilidad de ceros estructurales, coeficientes en escala logit)**\n\n")
}
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(s$coefficients$zi)) {
  as.data.frame(s$coefficients$zi) |>
    knitr::kable(digits = 3)
}
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
# nbinom2/zinb use theta (size) as the MLE dispersion parameter: var = mu + mu^2/theta
# very large theta means the NB fit collapsed toward the Poisson limit (no extra overdispersion)
if (family(fit)$family == "nbinom2") {
  theta_label <- if (s$sigma > 1000) {
    sprintf("%.3g (\u2248 sin sobredispersi\u00f3n adicional; l\u00edmite Poisson)", s$sigma)
  } else {
    sprintf("%.3f", s$sigma)
  }
  cat(sprintf("**Par\u00e1metro de dispersi\u00f3n (NB, $\\theta$):** %s\n\n", theta_label))
}
```

**Predicciones (abundancia esperada, escala de respuesta)**

```{r}
# ggeffect() (effects-package backend) fails on zero-inflated glmmTMB models
ggeffects::ggpredict(
  fit,
  terms = "distance [0, 15, 30, 45, 60, 75, 90, 100]"
) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  select(x, predicted, conf.low, conf.high) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 2, col.names = c("Distancia", "Predicho", "IC 2.5%", "IC 97.5%"))
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7.5
#| fig-height: 2.2
simulation_residuals <- DHARMa::simulateResiduals(fittedModel = fit, n = 1000)
par(mfrow = c(1, 3), cex = 0.55, mar = c(3, 3, 3, 1))
invisible(DHARMa::testUniformity(simulation_residuals))
invisible(DHARMa::testDispersion(simulation_residuals))
invisible(DHARMa::testZeroInflation(simulation_residuals))
```
